name.description: The unique identifier, as a string, of the view type to get or create.

posX.description: Initial position of the created view on the horizontal axis. Defaults to -1.

posY.description: Initial position of the created view on the vertical axis. Defaults to -1.

id.description: The unique ID of the view

examples.description: Gets a view, if it exists in the current layout, or creates a new one.
examples.title: Retrieving or creating a new view
